passport.appearance: young poet in his late twenties, energetic and impulsive presence, strong build, lively brown eyes, short tousled dark hair, expressive face with quick-changing emotions
passport.clothes: loose grey shirt, worn leather jacket, red scarf, open collar

voice.timbre: A young Russian male voice, bright tenor with an energetic edge. Native Russian pronunciation.
voice.manner: Fast and emotionally charged, speaks with conviction.

profile.baseline: restless and expressive; cannot stay still for long, gestures with his whole arms, shifts his weight, speaks fast and loud, face mirrors every emotion immediately
quirks: paces back and forth while reciting his own verses
wraps and unwraps his red scarf when he is nervous
runs a hand through his hair before every bold statement

reactions.reaction: lights up instantly, straightens to his full height and talks twice as fast
flares up defensively, argues back with sweeping gestures, then quickly deflates and becomes sullen and quiet
backs away, voice breaks into a higher pitch, clutches the nearest object with both hands
